items.q: Stevie Wonder. You know, they gave him one year to make an album. And we used to make -- Art Tatum used to make five and six in one day.

ctx.x: Stevie Wonder. You know, they gave him one year to make an album. And we used to make -- Art Tatum used to make five and six in one day. I made an album of 36 tunes in one day with Ella Fitzgerald. That's that album called '36 by Ella.'
